note: Two gates with different jobs. The per-seed ceilings are the 100th percentile plus ~20% headroom and catch catastrophic breakage of a single instrument. The mean gate is much tighter and is the sensitive one: a systematic regression moves the mean long before it pushes any single seed past its ceiling. Mean level offset is -0.11 dB, so no residual gain error remains.

knownOutlier.detail: One oscillator with delay and FM, no reverb. Peak level matches Chrome to 0.00 dB, so the instrument is not mis-levelled; the divergence is in the delay tail. Not yet attributed. It is the only seed above 6.1 dB, and the mean is unaffected.
